model.description: R32.7 EXPORT: PumlSerializer.modelToPuml serializes the MDA model (classes/interfaces + members + relations) to a valid @startuml...@enduml - each element emitted EXACTLY ONCE, deterministic order so re-export is BYTE-IDENTICAL, relations by M2 kind (generalization <|-- / association --> / dependency ..>, mirrors R32.6 EDGE_DEFS). Pure client-isolated puml-serializer.ts (no server endpoint = no boot risk), REUSE the diagram-view-model EdgeKind/DiagramNode/DiagramRelation + buildEdges de-dup. Sibling UC of puml.import.
